receipt.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, GBRP direct-plane packing, owned output allocation and release. For subsampled inputs, expand both ceil-sized chroma planes by their sampling factors and crop to the original grid inside every operation, including intermediate acquisition/release. Grayscale includes expanding owned decoded GRAY8 samples into independent RGBA8 inside every operation. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

decision.reason: Active two-AC-symbol lookup makes the complete operation slower; no independent confirmation or variants.

algorithm: Derive bounded eight-bit complete AC-symbol/amplitude pairs from each encoded canonical Huffman table. Reserve1024B/table before allocation, prepare only at ordinary baseline pixel scan use, preserve long/marker/short-tail/band-end fallbacks and exact logical reader state. No canceled/progressive/validation pairing. No upstream source/table copied.
correctness: Active candidate exact native/normal/scalar pixels, source integrity, independently owned outputs, frozen metadata/settings/native worker and both idle-v2 guards pass. Forty-nine focused internal and343 unaffected public checks pass normal/scalar on Linux. The candidate adds memory capacity;27 original public failures pin old exact byte peaks or ordinal cancellation triggers. Those requirements were not waived or declared qualified. Candidate is rejected before updating test expectations, full qualification or package production.

workflow.closedFamily: Eight-bit paired-AC prefix lookup; no width/table/layout/inlining variants.

preparationCorrections: Three three-actual executions are retained: first loaded the original core through linked benchmark dependencies and failed the mandatory identity gate; second loaded the first candidate but its frameSeen preparation guard left pairs inactive because this frozen input declares DHT before SOF; only the third exercises the active pairing algorithm and judges it. Correct physical dependencies and prepare at scan use; one additional core build, same unchanged internal-test build reused. Neither earlier execution supports a gain or rejection claim. Profile postcheck also requested an absent optional field and recovered the same terminal diagnostic without rerunning it. Runtime/bootstrap corrections reuse completed builds. No confidence/pixel/resource/quiet gate was relaxed.
